description: Election Commission - M. S. Mohanadas of the Kuchchavel Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Kuchchaveli Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party (All Ceylon Tamil Congress). This falls under electoral processes and local government elections, specifically addressing the status of an elected member, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
